# KTR Freight

> KTR Freight Pvt Ltd is an Asia–US 4PL logistics company. It controls the full lane — factory pickup in Asia, ocean/air freight, US customs clearance and DDP, drayage, company-operated warehouses in New Jersey, Chicago and Los Angeles, OTR trucking, project cargo/heavy haul, and final mile — on one contract with one accountable team. Specializes in energy-sector cargo: transformers, beams, coils, insulators, solar modules, semiconductors and data-centre equipment. Also runs Amazon FBA/AWD flows and scrap/recyclables exports. Offices in Gurugram and Mumbai, India, with 24/7 coverage of US operating hours. Contact: info@ktrfreight.com.

## Services
- [All services](https://ktrfreight.com/services): Drayage, OTR trucking, first mile, final mile, customs & DDP, warehousing, project cargo & heavy haul, Amazon freight, scrap, 4PL control tower

## Industries
- [Industries overview](https://ktrfreight.com/industries): Power transmission, solar & renewables, semiconductors, data centers, project cargo, Amazon sellers
